name: Dostoevsky
q: Better to err your own way
We are all responsible for each other
Man sometimes loves his own suffering
Great minds and deep hearts must suffer
If there is no God, all is permitted
Two times two is four is the start of death
Man is a creature that can get accustomed to anything
What is hell? The suffering of being unable to love
Suffering is the sole origin of consciousness
Above all, do not lie to yourself
My hosanna has passed through a great furnace of doubt
